newsitem.title: UK: NWE vacuum gas oil flat, tight, demand weak.
newsitem.headline: NWE vacuum gas oil flat, tight, demand weak.

text.p: European vacuum gas oil was notionally stable on Friday with a softer tone provided by weak gas oil futures, but traders said little product was available.
Low sulphur VGO barges were assessed at around $160-162 fob ARA but activity was muted.
The cargo market was tight, and quiet.

A low suphur piece, loading between October 20 and 30, was heard offered by a French refiner at around $165 fob NWE. A trader was also heard holding a Spanish piece but the offer number was not heard.
Bids were hard to find for either of these pieces, and U.S. arbitrage business was not considered workable, with netback prices working out somewhere in the mid to high 150s, fob NWE.
